grades.quote: Whether to allow software reads of the performance counter at the PLV1 privilege level. When this bit is 1, the PLV1 privilege level PCNT will not trigger an instruction privilege level error exception (IPE), if the CSRRD instruction is used to access any of the implemented performance counters at the PLV1 privilege level.
grades.reason: Provides narrow counter-access permissions, not the general roles of the privilege levels.
Lists tables without explaining privilege-level roles or access distinctions.

grades.quote: All privileged instructions are accessible only at the PLV0 privilege level. The only exception is that when the `RPERF1` / `RPERF2` / `RPERF3` in `CSR.MISC` is configured to `1` , the `CSRRD` instruction can be executed at PLV1/PLV2/PLV3 privilege level to read the performance counter.
grades.reason: Explains the principal privileged-instruction access distinction and its exception, but not each level's intended use.

grades.quote: The specific privilege level of the application is determined by the system software at runtime, and the application cannot accurately aware this. In LoongArch, the application usually runs on PLV3.
grades.reason: Identifies PLV3 as the usual application level and explains privilege assignment, but leaves the other levels' roles unspecified.
